title: VW and Skoda EV owners have waited years for battery preconditioning (InsideEVs)
notes: ID.4/ID.5 built 2020-2024 lacked battery preconditioning; from 2024 all came with automatic battery preconditioning; software 3.9.1 adds a manual button only (below 20 C). Market not stated (European-sourced).
